scripts.ci:version: bun scripts/scope-packages.ts ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER:-joelhooks} && changeset version && bun update
scripts.ci:publish: bun scripts/scope-packages.ts ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER:-joelhooks} && for dir in packages/*; do (cd "$dir" && bun publish --access public || true); done && changeset tag
